message.content:
I've investigated the issue thoroughly. The feature request asks for extra network items (checkpoints, hypernetworks, textual inversions, etc.) to be sorted by date by default when the extra networks interface opens.

Here's what I found:

1. **`modules/ui_extra_networks.py`** — This file defines the extra networks UI including the sort dropdown. Currently at line 384, the dropdown is initialized with `value='Default Sort'`, which means the default is no date sorting. This needs to change to a date-based sort (e.g., `'Date Created'`/`'Date Modified'`) to satisfy the request.

2. **`javascript/extraNetworks.js`** — This file contains the client-side sorting logic (`applySort`). Currently the sort is only applied when the user interacts with the sort dropdown or the invert-order button (`sort.dataset.sortkey = 'sortDefault'` is set and `applySort()` is never invoked during setup). Even if the Python default were changed, the initial card render (server-side order) would remain unchanged unless the JS also applies the default sort when the interface is opened/refreshed. This file needs modification to trigger the date sort on initial load.

The supporting sort infrastructure already exists: `get_sort_keys()` in `modules/ui_extra_networks.py` emits `data-sort-date_created`/`data-sort-date_modified`/`data-sort-name` attributes on each card, and the page subclasses (`ui_extra_networks_checkpoints.py`, `ui_extra_networks_hypernets.py`, `ui_extra_networks_textual_inversion.py`) already populate these sort keys — so no changes are needed there.
